title: Sequence analysis + scored QC gate
description: Normalize sample and run metadata to one canonical vocabulary, analyze, and gate interpretation on a scored review of QC and provenance.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-bio-02
  title: Sequence analysis + scored QC gate
  description: Normalize sample and run metadata to one canonical vocabulary, analyze, and gate interpretation
    on a scored review of QC and provenance.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Release a sequence analysis whose reference build, versions, and QC were declared and scored
    before any biological claim is attached to it.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Run outputs and sample metadata
      summary: Run outputs and sample metadata
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - sample_metadata
              - run_metrics
              - reference_build
              - analysis_parameters
            properties:
              sample_metadata: {}
              run_metrics: {}
              reference_build: {}
              analysis_parameters: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-normalize
      kind: transform
      name: Normalize to the canonical vocabulary
      summary: 'rename source metadata fields onto the canonical vocabulary: sample_id, batch, reference_build,
        tool_version, coverage'
      config:
        operation: rename
        expression: 'rename source metadata fields onto the canonical vocabulary: sample_id, batch, reference_build,
          tool_version, coverage'
    - id: n-specialist
      kind: agent
      templateRef: bio-02
      name: Run and audit the analysis
      summary: Specialist pass over normalized fields.
      role: Computational biologist running and auditing sequence analysis pipelines.
      prompt: You are a Bioinformatics Pipeline Analyst. You state the reference build, tool versions,
        and parameters behind every result, and you check coverage, duplication, contamination, and batch
        structure before interpreting any signal. You treat a pipeline result whose QC you have not inspected
        as unreported, because most surprising findings in sequence data are artifacts with a plausible
        biological story attached.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - clinical-review
          - domain-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:genomics-platform
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-score
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Scored teacher feedback
      summary: Score feedback from a host-resolved teacher model.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: You are the review teacher for this analysis. Score it on QC sufficiency, batch structure
        handling, version and reference declaration, and whether each stated finding survives its own
        QC. Return scores with the specific metric behind every deduction.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: score
    - id: n-gate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score the specialist result
      summary: Evaluate QC sufficiency, batch confounding, and completeness of version and provenance
        declarations.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against QC sufficiency, batch confounding, and completeness
        of version and provenance declarations. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind
        the verdict, remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic
        measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-pass
      kind: condition
      name: Above the bar?
      summary: Route on gate.passed.
      config:
        expression: gate.passed
        branches:
          - label: Pass
            when: 'true'
          - label: Rework
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-rework
      kind: agent
      templateRef: bio-06
      name: Repair the provenance and QC gaps
      summary: Corrective pass on the scored weaknesses.
      role: Data steward enforcing provenance, consent, and de-identification on biological data.
      prompt: You are a Research Data Steward. You verify that every dataset carries its provenance, consent
        scope, and de-identification status, and you block a use that exceeds the consent the data were
        collected under. You treat re-identification risk from combined datasets as a real risk rather
        than a theoretical one, and you state the specific fields that create it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
          - de-identification
          - teaching
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:lims
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - phi-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Principal investigator approves interpretation of the results
      summary: Pause for the principal investigator; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Sequence analysis + scored QC gate deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-bio-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-normalize
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-02-edge-2
      from: n-normalize
      to: n-specialist
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-02-edge-3
      from: n-specialist
      to: n-score
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-02-edge-4
      from: n-score
      to: n-gate
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-02-edge-5
      from: n-gate
      to: n-pass
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-02-edge-6
      from: n-pass
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-bio-02-edge-7
      from: n-pass
      to: n-rework
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-bio-02-edge-8
      from: n-rework
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-bio-02-edge-9
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
